painted-toon.title: Painted Toon
painted-toon.summary: Hand-painted textures pushed into cel shading: saturated colour in flat posterised tones, a hard cool shadow band under every form and a highlight band on top, from a mostly top-down light so the bands read from any heading. Pair with inklib outlines (0.05 studs) and cartoon geometry eyes on animals.
